mostWorthwhile.text: Following disk material into a cold cloud was most worthwhile: some grains survived and became seeds for further gathering.

leastWorthwhile.text: The tail-star combination was comparatively predictable: the stars heated and swept up the surrounding gas.

surprise.text: The nursery outflow helped initiate another generation of stars after disrupting its original gathering.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the combinations followed the stated goals, though the final one was the only available action.

continue.text: I would continue: following material between clouds and seeing an outflow contribute to new star formation made the story interesting.
